fenchel_family.proof: For u>=0 and -a<x<a, V0(x)-u*x - (V0(a)-u*a)=V0(x)+u*(a-x)>0. Use -a for u<=0. All global minimizers are outside the support of h, so V1*=V0*.

scope: V1 illustrative bump chosen for this figure, not a recovered historical parameter set.
Fenchel conjugacy of potentials and P_n fibers of states are different equivalence relations.
Adding h changes V0 derivative, so the same T3 tree is not asserted for V1.
Inverse states are not all stable equilibria.
No human-data fit or ARC performance claim.
